scope: Four owner-selected completed research figures imported unchanged for the NWSW portfolio. Selection numbers refer to the displayed review list: 1, 3, 7, and 17.

figures.scope: Retained cutoff display with different source windows, units and location methods. Mexico uses published positions; Guatemala and U.S. animal positions are simulated. Apparent densities are not comparable across countries. Sources, credits and Equal Earth projection remain in the figure.

Four million conditional allocations per panel for the same 20 Farm references. Fixed classes, extent and ramp; simulated occupancy probability per 20 km cell. These are possible locations under stated rules, not observed farms.

Model from 52 confirmations through October 3 versus 56 later confirmations through November 3. Each panel is normalized to its own total, using matching county geometry, extent, EPSG:5070, classes and colors. Census TIGER/Line 2025 counties and APHIS export retrieved November 7. County averages do not locate premises.

figures.placement: Border and environmental context; replaces the older highway figure
figures.scope: Selected 150 km band on each side of the border in mapped arid/semiarid classes. Not a measured journey, transmission route or infection probability. U.S. animal positions are simulated. Beck et al. 2023 CC BY 4.0, WOAH and other source credits are retained within the complete figure.

accessibility: Descriptive alt text, adjacent plain-language captions and full-size links are provided. Shared map legends and source credits are preserved. No new classification, geographic analysis or recoloring was performed.
